name: Hourray: Private Time Tracker
notes: Vesper is now called Hourray. It's the same extension, and your days, settings and backups carry over. Hourray counts your hours for you: a clean summary of your day, Review the day with the times you actually worked on each line, Say what it was for time away from Chrome, settings, review and exports in a side panel if you like, text size, Copy my day, and timesheets by project.
